title: Offer a callback instead of a hold
summary: Collect the caller's number and context, end the held call, then call them back with that context.
scenario: Queues that do not waste the caller's time

evidence: features Max wait cap -> callback enrollment; queue_dispatch._offer_callback_and_release
features: redirecting a live waiting leg to new SWML is not possible - design the release, do not promise a redirect
